summary: GD Culture Group Ltd filed an 8-K reporting Nasdaq's notice that it regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price rule for continued listing on the Nasdaq Capital Market. The company, a Nevada corporation headquartered in Jersey City, NJ, received the notice on July 29, 2026. The filing, made under Item 8.01, discloses that the matter is closed. The company's CEO and Chairman, Xiao Jian Wang, signed the report. The 8-K also incorporates this event by reference into its Form S-3 registration statement. No financial terms or specific bid price levels were disclosed. Watch for any future listing-related developments or price sustainability.
